title: Battle of Gonaïves
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Gonaïves", at revision 1370110941, opens: "The Battle of Gonaïves took place during the Haitian Revolution." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2890666, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1794 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
